summary: Frontend regression for FixitZ (7 items). All 7 features verified working on production preview via Playwright (mobile 430x900). Admin/customer flows exercised end-to-end. Theme restored to Shopee-orange as required.

features_tested.evidence: GET /api/search?q=iphone -> 1 product + 22 repair models rendered; both 'Products (1)' and 'Repair Models (22)' sections visible with data-testid=search-page. 'charger' returned 2 products + 0 repairs (repair section still renders count).

/admin/free-products loads with data-testid=admin-free-products, sidebar link present, all 3 sections ('Claims Awaiting Approval (1)', 'Free Products (2)', 'Make a Product Free') render. Make Free -> Unset round-trip succeeded (PUT /api/admin/products/<id> 200 twice; makefree-<id> reappeared).
Add Coupon modal opens; field-type select options = ['','flat','percent','free_product']. 'Free Product ID (for Free Product type)' input field is visible in the form.

setting-primaryColor / setting-accentColor / setting-pageBg + settings-save all present. Set primary to #1E88E5 -> Save (toast 'Settings updated' shown, PUT /api/admin/settings 200) -> home reloaded with --fx-primary=#1E88E5 (Book Repair button rendered blue). Restored to #EE4D2D/#D0011B/#F8F7F5 -> --fx-primary=#EE4D2D confirmed after reload (theme returned to orange).
hero-banner bounding box = 430x648 on 430x900 viewport (ratio 0.72 == h-[72vh]), edge-to-edge (width == viewport width, no rounded card margin).

Product page /product/<id> shows 'More Products' section with data-testid=related-products and horizontally scrollable related-<id> cards each with a + add-to-cart button. Sticky Add to Cart + Buy Now buttons remain visible above bottom nav.

Splash.jsx source contains logo 'F', 'FixitZ' title, tagline, 'tap to enter' text and 14 decorative speedlines, but NO thin animated horizontal loading bar div under the tagline. Splash dismisses correctly on tap.

minor_observations: ProductDetail sticky CTA buttons use data-testid 'pd-add-cart' / 'pd-buy-now' (not 'add-to-cart' / 'buy-now' as named in the review-request wording). Buttons are visible & functional; only a docs/testid-naming mismatch.
'Free Product ID' input on Add Coupon modal has no data-testid attribute (label + input are present and functional). Consider adding data-testid='coupon-free-product-id' for automated testing.
ThemeInjector sets CSS vars --fx-primary, --fx-primary-hover, --fx-bg (not --fx-accent / --fx-page-bg). Naming inconsistency with settings field names but visually correct.
action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='coupon-free-product-id' on the Free Product ID input in AdminCoupons.
(Optional) Align sticky CTA testids on ProductDetail with review naming (add-to-cart / buy-now) OR update docs.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeInjector: hexTint fallback returns a hard-coded orange '#FFF0EC' on parse failure; consider deriving from current primary instead.
Splash: audio autoplay attempt via new AudioContext() in useEffect is fine but 'played' flag lives outside listener scope on each render; harmless but could be moved into a ref.
seed_data_creation: None. Free-product make/unset round-trip left DB in original state (product reverted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash appears only once per session (sessionStorage key fx_splash); tap [data-testid=splash-screen] to dismiss. When testing theme, always restore to #EE4D2D/#D0011B/#F8F7F5 at the end. Sticky CTAs on product page use pd-add-cart/pd-buy-now testids. Shop cards are div not <a> — navigate via /product/<pid> extracted from data-testid=shop-product-<pid>.
